data.assumption: “Median order value in Singapore last month” means the discrete median of non-test Singapore showroom orders’ total_minor by business_date during August 2026.
data.sql:
SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.total_minor) AS median_order_value_minor
FROM orders o
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN countries c ON c.country_code = s.country_code
WHERE o.is_test = FALSE
  AND c.name = 'Singapore'
  AND o.business_date >= DATE '2026-08-01'
  AND o.business_date < DATE '2026-09-01'
